evidence.requirements: Nearly everything in the brief is in place. List with heading, search over alternative names, Family select and "<n> cartridges" (app.js:49-77). Detail facts, capacity with source link, grouped Symbol/Value/Unit tables, Print button and "All cartridges" link, hash address #/cartridge/<key> (app.js:81-154). Tolerances sit beside their values, never as rows (format.js:44-66). Angles show as 40° or 39°59'49". Symbol map follows the brief (format.js:7-11). Inline SVG with aria-label "<name> drawing", section hatching, dash-dot centre line, title block with name, table, revision, "Dimensions in mm" and scale (drawing.js:227-301). Missing values are named under the drawing (app.js:118-120). Partly met: (1) α is a text label with a leader arrow pointing at the shoulder, not an angular dimension with extension lines (drawing.js:194-212; detail-308_win.jpg 'α 40°'). (2) In print the drawing is capped at 105 mm high (styles.css:179), so the outline covers only about a third of the page width, not 'full width' (print-308_win.jpg). (3) The title-block scale is only the A4 print scale; the on-screen drawing is at some other scale.
evidence.correctness: The geometry follows the rules and is checked against hand-worked values. Rim type thresholds (geometry.js:24-31). Chamfer min(f·tanβ, R1/4). Rimfire half-round. Groove ramp to (P1/2, E). Belt ramp at δ to R3/2, then along the belt to E (geometry.js:46-103). Shoulder through (P2/2, L1)–(H1/2, L2) with r1 min/r2 fillets (geometry.js:133-164). Bullet seating-depth and k factors, tangent-ogive ρ and centre, quarter ellipse, cones (geometry.js:197-259). Heeled 22 LR heel at H2−2·tb. Walls tn/tb, w, pocket sizes (geometry.js:263-286). Outlines match the references in proportion: 308 neck and shoulder, 300 Win. Mag. belt, 9 mm round-nose taper, 22 LR rounded rim and heel. Label values match the data. Print fits one A4 page (print.test.js; print-308_win.jpg). Defects: head-face and L3 extension lines run through the length labels ('L1 39.62 -0.2' and 'L2 43.48 -0.2' on detail-308_win.jpg; 'L3 19.15 -0.25' is crossed twice on detail-9_mm_luger.jpg). α is not drawn as an angle dimension. The diameter extension lines on the right (G1, H2, H1, P2) run over the bullet and neck as near-coincident lines, which makes the outline hard to read.
evidence.security: All data written through innerHTML is escaped with esc() (app.js:13-15, 43-45, 84-110, 122-131; drawing.js:18-20, 264, 290). A unit test checks escaping (drawing.test.js:56-62). No eval or Function. No external requests: the only external URLs are user-clicked links with rel=noopener noreferrer. The e2e watch() fails on any network request (e2e/helpers.js:14-20).
evidence.code_quality: Clear split into format, geometry (no DOM), drawing layout/SVG and app/router. Small IIFE modules work both in the browser and under Node require. Names are domain terms (GLOSSARY.md). Minor issues: sectionModel takes unused params (outer, shoulder) and returns inner:null that build() then replaces (geometry.js:263-286). The heeled-bullet guard builds an awkward absent({P1}) (geometry.js:223-226). drawing.layout is a long function (~180 lines) of magic font-size multipliers. esc/has are duplicated between files.
evidence.tests: Thorough and meaningful. Unit tests check every drawing rule with hand-computed coordinates: rim types at their thresholds, chamfer limit, rimfire half-round, groove, belt, fillet tangent points, ogive circle, ellipse, cones, heel, walls, w, pocket sizes by primer type, and missing-value messages (test/unit/*.js). Drawing tests cover labels, true scale, escaping, title block, and label/outline overlap for all 25 records. Playwright tests cover file:// and http, search, family filter, reload/back, tables, print dialog, a one-page A4 PDF for all 25 in dark mode, ≥6 pt print labels, phone width and dark mode. The one gap: nothing checks extension lines crossing labels, which is visible in the screenshots.
evidence.ux_design: The facts grid, then drawing, then dense four-column tables make a sound hierarchy for a technical audience, and tabular numbers are right-aligned (detail-308_win.jpg). The drawing itself is poorly balanced: labels are ~5.7 mm high next to a 12 mm-wide case, so the outline is a thin strip and the groove, chamfer, primer pocket and section walls are hard to see. The title block is huge, wider than the cartridge on detail-22_long_rifle.jpg and detail-9_mm_luger.jpg. Extension lines strike through labels. In print, everything fits one page but the drawing is small and the lower half of the page is empty (print-308_win.jpg). Dark mode exists in CSS and is tested, but no screenshot shows it.
evidence.accessibility: SVG has role=img and an aria-label (drawing.js:264). Tables have captions and th scope=col/row (app.js:106-110). Inputs have real labels. The count is role=status aria-live (app.js:59). There is a skip link, focus moves to h1 on route change (app.js:157-165), :focus-visible outlines, and lang=en. Contrast is good (muted #59616a on #fafaf7). The drawing's text alternative is only its name, though the tables carry the values. The search placeholder is cut off ('Name or alternative r', list.jpg).
evidence.simplicity: No runtime dependencies and no build step. About 900 lines of app JS, plus one dev dependency (Playwright) for e2e. Node's built-in test runner is used for unit tests. The size fits the problem.
evidence.maintainability: README covers layout, setup and test commands. GLOSSARY.md documents the domain terms. There are tests on both levels, and a package-lock pins Playwright. Missing: no CI configuration. No ADRs or spec in the delivered repo (the README points to .scratch/cartridge-database/, which is not present). No engines field or .nvmrc for Node 22. No release or versioning notes beyond version 1.0.0. The devDependency uses a caret range.
evidence.visual_design: The UI chrome is calm and consistent: small uppercase captions, thin rules, restrained blue links, tabular numbers (list.jpg, detail-*.jpg). The drawing clashes with it: oversized monospace labels and a huge bold title block dwarf a thin, small outline, and the hatching is faint at that size. It reads like a prototype, not a finished engineering drawing.
evidence.layout: No horizontal overflow; e2e tests the phone width (app.test.js:157-176). The tables grid aligns well. Within the drawing, the cartridge takes a small share of the canvas while labels and the title block take most of it. Length labels hang left past the head face. In print, about 45% of the A4 page is left blank below the tables while the drawing is capped small (print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.usability: Tasks take few steps. Live search over names and alternative names, a family filter, and the filter state is kept when returning (app.test.js:80-89). Bookmarkable addresses, a not-found view, one-click Print. 'Not drawn' notes explain missing values. The count reads '1 cartridges' (unpluralised, though that follows the brief's wording) and the search placeholder is truncated.
evidence.reception: Reloaders and engineers would trust the data presentation: values exactly as published, tolerances in place, C.I.P. source footer. The drawing, the centrepiece, looks out of proportion, with giant labels, struck-through text, a tiny case and a dominant title block. It compares poorly with the OpenBallistics reference drawings, and that would hurt first impressions and recommendations.

unmet_requirements: Shoulder angle α is a text label with a leader arrow, not an angular dimension line with extension lines (drawing.js:194-212)
Labels are crossed by extension lines (L1/L2 by the head-face line on 308 Win., L3 twice on 9 mm Luger), which hurts legibility
Print: the drawing is capped at 105 mm height, so the outline does not span the page width ('drawing at full width' is only partly met)
Title-block scale is valid only for A4 print, not for the on-screen drawing
strengths: Faithful implementation of every geometry rule (rim types, chamfer, groove, belt, fillets, ogive and ellipse noses, heeled bullet, walls, primer pocket), with missing values named instead of invented
Very strong test suite: hand-computed unit tests for each rule, plus Playwright checks for file:// and http, one-page A4 PDF for all 25 records, phone width, dark mode and label overlap
Correct, escaped, dependency-free data presentation: values, tolerances, angles and units exactly as the brief specifies, in clean grouped tables
issues: Drawing proportions: labels about 5.7 mm high and an oversized title block dwarf the to-scale cartridge, so the groove, chamfer, pocket and section walls are barely visible, on screen and in print
Extension lines strike through dimension labels, and α is only a leader label, not a proper angular dimension
Maintainability gaps: no CI, no ADRs or spec in the repo, no pinned Node version
review.verdict: Data handling, geometry rules and tests are excellent, and the app meets almost every functional requirement of the brief. The drawing, the core deliverable, is poorly balanced, with oversized labels, a dominant title block, struck-through text and a non-dimensioned α, so it needs a layout pass before publishing to a technical audience.
